title: Alpha-TCM: Auditable Knowledge Integration for Multimodal TCM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.38754v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge-guided multimodal systems need a way to measure how supplied knowledge affects predictions, including when that knowledge is wrong. Alpha-TCM addresses this problem for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) through an implemented workflow that separates measurements, supplied knowledge, predictions, and reviewer decisions. Observations and contextual knowledge enter separately, and a replaceable prior allows controlled interventions with fixed modality encoders. Bayesian committee accounting removes the reference prior already contained in each encoder before inserting contextual knowledge. A fully simulated confirmation study uses ten paired seeds and four training sizes. Knowledge context reduces prediction error relative to knowledge-free fusion at 600 and 1,200 training cases; equal-information learned context is competitive at 600 and has lower error at larger sizes. translated_title: Alpha-TCM：面向多模态中医推理的可审计知识集成
translated_abstract: 知识引导的多模态系统需要一种方法来衡量所提供的知识如何影响预测结果，包括当这些知识出错时的影响。Alpha-TCM 针对中医（TCM）场景解决了这一问题，它通过一个已实现的工作流程，将测量数据、所提供的知识、预测结果和审查者的决策彼此分离。观察数据与背景知识分别独立输入，可替换的先验使得在固定模态编码器的条件下能够进行受控干预。贝叶斯委员会核算方法在插入背景知识之前，先移除每个编码器中已经包含的参考先验。一项完全模拟的验证研究使用了十对配对随机种子和四种训练规模。结果表明：在 600 和 1,200 个训练样本时，知识背景相对于无知识的融合方法降低了预测误差；等信息量的学习型背景在 600 个样本时具有竞争力，而在更大规模时误差更低。受控的知识损坏实验能够识别出过度自信和分散……
tldr: Alpha-TCM 提出一个可审计的多模态中医推理工作流，通过分离测量、知识、预测与审查决策，并利用贝叶斯委员会核算量化所注入知识（包括被损坏的错误知识）对预测的影响，实验证明知识背景在中低训练规模下能显著降低预测误差。
en_tdlr: Alpha-TCM presents an auditable workflow for multimodal TCM inference that separates measurements, supplied knowledge, predictions, and reviewer decisions, using Bayesian committee accounting to quantify how injected (even corrupted) knowledge affects predictions, with experiments showing knowledge context reduces error at small-to-medium training scales.
